title: Geizhals Price History Scraper
description: Track Geizhals prices by product and market with history timestamps, observed prices, and current range values. Batch product IDs and choose a lookback window.

batch.title: Product IDs
batch.description: Geizhals product IDs whose price history you want to review.
batch.valueDescription: Geizhals product identifier used for this price history.

schema.description: Known Geizhals product id from product URLs such as ...-a2194110.html.
History window in days. Defaults to 31. Maximum 3650.
Market code: de, at, eu, pl, or uk. Defaults to de.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Geizhals Price History | Track Price Changes
storeCopy.seoDescription: Track Geizhals price history by product ID with timestamps, observed prices, and current range values. Choose a history window and export market trends.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve Geizhals price-history points for a product ID, including timestamps and recorded prices. Choose a lookback window and market to compare changes over time.
useCases: Price analysts can chart historical changes for a product catalog.
Retail teams can review low and high points before updating price rules.
Shoppers can compare recent price movement across multiple product IDs.
howToUse: Add one Geizhals product ID to `product_ids` for each history lookup.
Choose the market and number of days to include.
Set `maxResults` to cap the saved history points, then export the rows.

faqs.question: What does one result represent?
faqs.answer: Each row is one recorded price point with its source timestamp and price value.

fields.name: timestamp_ms
fields.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for this price observation.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for this price observation.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Product price recorded at this timestamp, in the selected Geizhals market currency.

fields.name: marker
fields.description: Geizhals chart marker describing the type of price-history point.

fields.name: input_product_id
fields.description: Product id submitted to retrieve this price point.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this dataset record was collected.
